shared_elements: human figure(s) shown in low relief with elaborate ornamented costume
feathered/plumed elements rendered as rows of repeated overlapping marks
patterned infill on garments (grids, rows of beads/scales)
arms extended holding/reaching across the field
justification: Both surfaces depict ornately costumed human figures in shallow relief whose garments and plumage are filled with dense repeated linear/beaded patterning, and both include a small circular rosette-like disc ornament. But the depicted scenes differ substantially: A shows a complete standing figure with a towering headdress dominating a small crouching figure, accompanied by a block panel of sign-like squares, whereas B shows overlapping large wings and fringed sleeves of winged attendant figures with no comparable dominance scene or sign panel, and the two use different bodily proportions and outline conventions.
